entities.name: Abdul Hamid II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdul Hamid II, a notable figure in the history of Armenia, associated with Russian Conquest and National Awakening (1878–1914). Preceded by Russo-Turkish War gains Kars and Ardahan for Russia and Treaty of Turkmenchay — Eastern Armenia ceded from Persia to Russia. Their legacy influenced Hamidian massacres kill an estimated 100,000–300,000 Armenians and Adana massacre during the counter-revolution.
